parts.text: F: CH. LITTLE THUNDER OF BIG-FOOT DE THALEK

parts: Litter out of cross our stud Little Thunder with our girl Thaila united the most important European blood-lines. They are grandchildrens of our beautiful girl Wanda. Repeating our C and E litters.
Litter born on 3 of December, 2003. They have been eight puppies of which four have been boys and four girls.
